title: Evidence Press reader-first release-page contract
purpose: Make every release intelligible, useful and safely reusable without forcing identical prose or retroactively inventing historical metadata.
personalAttributionRule: Operational names belong in machine-readable provenance, not routine reader prose or narration. Historical scholarly creator and citation records are changed only additively.
correctionMaterialityRule: Public correction panels contain claim, formula, evidence, assurance, attribution, citation, objection, retraction, supersession or safe-reuse changes. Routine audio, video, art, thumbnail, cache and deployment maintenance belongs in the presentation-event ledger.
grandfatheringRule: Records predating schema 2.0 retain their authored evidence history. The linter reports missing reader functions for grandfathered records but fails current records or explicitly upgraded records.
